## Contracts and risk

- [ ] Focused regression coverage proves the changed behavior and failure path.
- [ ] The full repository gates pass.
- [ ] API, configuration, operations, security, performance, architecture, ADR,
      localized onboarding, and Changelog owners were updated where triggered.
- [ ] No credential, private inventory, telemetry export, generated artifact, or
      unrelated local change is included.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, rollback, concurrency, resource, and browser
      impacts are either unchanged or explained above.
